d: The burned remains of two people are discovered in an Ohio basement; investigators are able to identify the victims and discover a crowbar that might lead them to the psychopath.
After an electrician is poisoned, the world's leading forensic pathologist is brought in to catch his killer.
When the body of a 24-year-old truck-stop waitress is discovered in North Carolina, it will take more than a decade and cutting-edge science to track down her killer.
Police crack down on illegal immigrants during rush hour in Calais, France.
A man from Pakistan claiming to be a student is refused entry into Britain after two days of questioning.

A woman arrives at Heathrow from Cape Town claiming she's there for a training course; in reality, she's come to earn money to send back home; officer Kay Lomas is handed the case of a "student" who is trying to re-enter the country from India.
Veteran Diesel takes on Billy, the new puppy on the block, as they hunt for hidden heroin, but Diesel later causes annoyance for his handler PC Adele Gibson during a crackdown on knives and drugs.
PC Greaves and his German Shepherd Riley foil some teenage thieves in the process of robbing a discount store.
German Shepherd Charlie reaches the mandatory retirement age for police service; during one of his final shifts with PC John Tozer, he tracks and locates a suspect hiding after a robbery attempt.
London's dog squad is back in action as a stabbing brings together two of London's top German Shepherd dog teams: PC Paul Caruana and Merlin and PC Andy Miller and Nelson.

At a reporting center, asylum seekers, foreign criminals and those caught working illegally come to make weekly reports and show they are following instructions while their paperwork and legal status is processed.

Immigration officer Lisa Lea checks the passport of a man from Pakistan who says he's doing marketing for his fruit and vegetable business; Lisa is suspicious about his passport stamps and finds out he's running illegal businesses.

At Heathrow's Terminal Three, officers stop a student from entering the UK after a trip home to his native India, while the team in Calais search lorries they suspect are being used to smuggle illegal immigrants.
A focus on criminals who have been brought to justice for a crime only to be released to commit further terrible acts.
One of the UK's biggest sex trafficking rings is uncovered in Rochdale in 2012; in a catalogue of abuse, girls as young as 13 were subjected to rape and torture by a gang of nine men.
Dermot Murnaghan returns to uncover the truth behind the horrific crimes of Peterborough serial killer Joanna Dennehy.

Keith Blakelock is murdered during a riot on a housing estate in North London triggered after a black woman died of heart failure during a house search; Keith received more than 40 injuries during the sustained attack from a number of rioters.
Peter Tobin raped and murdered three young girls: Dinah McNicol, Vicky Hamilton, and Angelika Kluk; he has a history of violence, raping two 14-year-old girls and leaving them for dead.
